finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, pooled and uniform advantage is excluded under both interval methods. Useful donor advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed writer/prompt resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor and pooled useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods; residual uniform is excluded only under writer resampling. All residual intervals include zero. Raw base and pooled useful advantages are excluded under writer resampling but remain unresolved under crossed resampling; raw donor remains unresolved under both, with all model-rival raw intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Sparse histories, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed or rank ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
